dedupe_keys.name: wind turbine blade lightning strike multimodal sensor data

description: The wind-turbine blade monitoring team publishes synchronized sensor measurements around a lightning-strike event. Coverage is one monitored turbine during this incident. The Figshare version 5 deposit lists CSV files for vibration, load, extended load, strain, extended strain and temperature, plus a README. The describing article places the observations from the start of the incident through the subsequent fault interval. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The data can help test blade-damage detection and lightning-response assumptions in wind-farm resilience simulations. No directly related catalogue record was identified. A caveat is that one monitored blade and event do not define a general failure probability. Sensor placement, timing alignment and turbine operating state need checking before deriving a fragility curve. The own metadata and file manifest were inspected; CSV rows, waveform quality and fault diagnosis were not independently verified. No custom analysis code is claimed for this deposit.
